title: Set up Tawdheef with your agent
description: Start the app, copy the setup request into your agent, then choose companies and actions.

title: Connect Codex or Claude Code
description: Choose Codex or Claude Code in Connections and copy the setup request into that client.

title: Create or connect your CV
description: Create or reuse a Tabbio CV. Your agent connects it and reads your current experience.

title: Add a country directory
description: Download a free country pack from GitHub, extract it and import every CSV part into your chosen tab.

title: Find matching jobs and build career profiles
description: Choose companies and Run actions. Continue in your agent and track confirmed outcomes.

title: Check replies and reports
description: Ask your agent to check tracked replies and new jobs, then keep a local report. Monitoring is read-only.

title: Fix a setup or run problem
description: Find the next fix for startup, assistant sign-in, CV reads, browser tools, email setup or incomplete pack imports.

title: Use Tawdheef as an agent
description: Read the local tool contract, discover public packs and record actual outcomes within the requested scope.
